decision_scope: Approve exact frozen technical candidate for public source PR; final public delivery remains conditional.
reason: The finite browser workflow now provides actual four-direction conversions, explicit loss consent/refusal reports, authenticated paired downloads, honest cancellation, linked retry and restart persistence. Actual screenshot, observations, separate fresh Emotion9 and independent QA receipts support the stable customer criteria. Frozen scope preserves known report/retention/cancellation boundaries and does not equate technical acceptance with final delivery.
conditions: Both push and pull_request CI must succeed for exact finalHEAD with all required steps
Root and independent QA must each anonymously download and compare the complete exact public source, then actually replay downloaded-source audits
Owned native processes must be closed with scoped capture limitations preserved; capacity and free-floor checks must pass
No080 release/tag, enterprise readiness, hardRAMcap, instant cancellation or general powerloss guarantee is accepted by this vote
Optional capacity stage starts only after primary acceptance and public delivery
